relations: The thrower's upward arm motion imparts initial velocity to the snowball, sending it rising above the snow surface.
As the snowball travels through the air, aerodynamic drag and internal stress cause it to fragment into a loose cloud.
The fragmented snow pieces scatter and slow, drifting downward while maintaining material continuity with the original snowball.
caption: Someone throws a snowball into the air, it breaks apart during flight.
